optionTag: Plan A · 15 ft ICU · Forecourt utility · Under-stair pantry · G+2
optionTrade: Plan A kitchen, ICU, forecourt washing bay, pantry, stacked stairs and the enlarged first-floor bedroom are retained. Removing the unused second-floor east passage tail reduces the clear landing/gallery from 135.9 to 124.3 sq ft; it remains 37.2 sq ft larger than the delivered stacked-gallery revision. A continuous metal-and-teak guard closes the shortened end and joins the atrium edge. The coordinated enclosure, atrium and walls previously reduced the roof terrace by 106.5 sq ft; it remains 477.2 sq ft open. The family hall, stairs, first and ground floors, terraces, opaque highest roof and glazed atrium are unchanged by this landing revision.
title: Tirumala 5
disclaimer: PRELIMINARY - ENGINEER TO REVIEW - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
orientation: East road/front (40 ft = 12.192 m, y=0) · South left (x=0) · North 12 m road/right (50 ft = 15.240 m, x=12.192 m) · West rear (y=15.240 m). Overhead 2D plans show West at top and North on right.
notes: Tirumala 5 — selected Plan A, based on Tirumala 4. 40 × 50 ft; 15 ft wide ICU; kitchen against south wall; 7 × 4.5 ft forecourt utility; dry pantry below high stair flight. Ground room sizes, ground staircase and parking retained. Living entrance shifted 100 mm north, ICU living opening 150 mm south, extra corner gap closed while drawing and rear-lobby access remain. ICU recliner head south, feet north. Utility screened in ivory and teak. G+2 revision: an indoor gallery beside the east glazing leads to a South–West–North upper staircase aligned directly above the original ground stair, with an enclosed second landing and family hall. The first north guest bedroom extends one foot south in its front portion; its rear wall retains the three-foot circulation passage. The small balcony, connector and projecting corner remain removed. Main terrace retained with opaque ivory parapets. The double-height opening remains beside the indoor gallery and the hanging disc pendants are removed. Large 3200 × 1600 mm slabs, substantial glazing, teak joinery and coordinated roof/beam expression. Structural dimensions are architectural concept placeholders pending engineering.
